svg.aria-label: Any model plugs into one sovereign context layer, which feeds agents that run operations. Models are hot-swapped while the context layer and the agents keep running without interruption.

g.aria-label: L01 Any model. Frontier or open-weight, any model docks into the same context. Swap it or route per task without resetting a single memory.

g.text: hover a chip to dock it

g.aria-label: L02 Sovereign context layer. Your institutional context lives here: owned by you, portable, and independent of any model vendor. It survives every swap.
L03 Agents that operate. Sales, support, ops and research agents keep running on the same context while the model underneath them changes.

g.text: HOVER A LAYER OR DOCK A MODEL
